title: Screenshot2Code transforms screenshots into live #Screenshot2Code #AIbreakthrough #webdevelopment
description: Screenshot2Code created a tool that converts screenshots into fully functional websites. Developed by Abhiraja, it has gained over 72,800 stars and 9,000 forks on GitHub and is open source under the MIT license. The tool uses advanced Frontier Vision AI models like Gemini 3 Pro, GPT 5.5, and Claude Opus 4.8 for layout, typography, spacing, and color detection to generate editable code with live preview. It also integrates Flux for placeholder images to enhance visual polish beyond wireframes. Screenshot2Code offers both hosted and self-hosted options with API key privacy, enabling designers, developers, and startups to rapidly prototype interfaces without manual coding. This innovation addresses the growing need for faster, scalable UI prototyping powered by AI. #Screenshot2Code #Abhiraja #FrontierVision #Gemini3Pro #GPT5_5 #ClaudeOpus48 #AIWebDesign #OpenSourceProject #WebDevelopment #UIDesign #PrototypingTool #FluxPlaceholder #AIinnovation #DeveloperTools #TechInnovation
